title: Bok Choi Stir Fry with Kleftiko Sausage
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with tender bok choy and warm, garlicky kleftiko sausage.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced kleftiko sausage and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped bok choy and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the freshly squeezed lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
